open_questions.question: Is Claude (the AI model, l0:claude) available-on iPhone 15 Pro specifically, or does the Claude iOS app target a broader iOS/iPhone range?

candidate_edge.verification_route: Fetch App Store listing for Claude app (id6473753684) for minimum iOS version and device compatibility; confirm iPhone 15 Pro runs the required iOS version.

open_questions.proposed_route: App Store fetched 2026-06-11 shows iOS 18.0+ requirement. iPhone 15 Pro supports iOS 18 (per Wikidata). Therefore Claude IS available-on iPhone 15 Pro. Convert to fact in sweep-2 with App Store URL + iOS compatibility source as independent second route. The available-on edge belongs on the claude wrapper (claude -[available-on]-> iphone-15-pro), not on this wrapper's relations[] — not yet backed by a relation fact in l0_catalog.relations.jsonl.

open_questions.question: Does the 'first 3nm smartphone chip' claim (A17 Pro) hold as a kernel fact? Any competitor released a 3nm chip before September 2023?
open_questions.proposed_route: Multiple sources (Apple Newsroom, PhoneArena, 9to5Mac) assert first commercially-released 3nm smartphone chip. Sweep-2: check Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 release date and process node to confirm no prior competitor claim. This is a membrane-hardening priority because the 'first' claim is a kernel candidate once corroborated.

open_questions.question: Was the iPhone 15 Pro the very first iPhone with USB-C (vs. first with USB 3 speeds via USB-C)?
open_questions.proposed_route: The entire iPhone 15 lineup (not just Pro) moved from Lightning to USB-C in 2023. iPhone 15 Pro was first with USB 3.0/3.2 speeds; iPhone 15 (non-Pro) got USB-C at USB 2.0 speeds. Fetch Apple's iPhone 15 (non-Pro) specs page to confirm. Distinctions matter for the connector_type fact's notes.

open_questions.proposed_route: Skip unless a textbook or encyclopedia explicitly traces this lineage to consumer smartphones.

open_questions.proposed_route: No plausible direct edge. Indirect two-hop (Hodges book -> Turing -> AI -> Claude -> iPhone 15 Pro) is too many hops to be a first-class relation. Skip.
